definitions.explanation: Not necessary or required. The negation of {必要|ひつよう} (necessary). Used to describe things that can be omitted or are not essential.

examples.japanese: {不必要|ふひつよう}な{出費|しゅっぴ}は{避|さ}けたい。
examples.english: I want to avoid unnecessary expenses.

examples.japanese: その{説明|せつめい}は{不必要|ふひつよう}だと{思|おも}います。
examples.english: I think that explanation is unnecessary.

examples.japanese: {不必要|ふひつよう}な{心配|しんぱい}はしないでください。

notes:
Na-adjective formed by adding the negative prefix {不|ふ} to {必要|ひつよう} (necessary).

FORMS:
・{不必要|ふひつよう}な + noun ({不必要|ふひつよう}な{物|もの} = unnecessary things)
・{不必要|ふひつよう}に + verb ({不必要|ふひつよう}に{心配|しんぱい}する = worry unnecessarily)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{不要|ふよう} - unneeded (more common in compounds)
・{無駄|むだ} - wasteful, useless
・いらない - don't need (casual)
